items.title: Trump Calls Putin His FRIEND, Sleeps During President Xi’s Speech & Grand Theft Auto VI Mania!
items.desc: Grand Theft Auto VI is out now and internet usage is at an all-time high, our announce Lou is super excited about it, Trump was in China today for his big summit where he referred to Putin as his friend and appeared to fall asleep during President Xi’s speech even though the White House forcefully denied it, people across America are panic buying in case all hell breaks loose, and This Week in Unnecessary Censorship.

topics: Grand Theft Auto VI launch excitement and people skipping work to play
Trump calling Putin his friend at the China summit
Trump appearing to doze during Xi’s speech and the White House denial
jokes: Kimmel compared the GTA craze to workers calling out and joked about a man getting ten days to play after his wife signed a contract.
He teased announcer Lou for gaming in a headset while Guillermo’s gaming experience stopped at Pac-Man and Mario Bros.
Kimmel joked that Trump’s summit with Putin and Xi looked like a gathering of movie villains.
He poked fun at the White House explanation that Trump was looking at papers while appearing to nod off.
The censorship segment made ordinary TV clips sound scandalous by adding bleeps.
questions: Which new video game had Lou excited?
What was the White House’s explanation for Trump appearing to doze during Xi’s speech?
